chunks: A gathering whose host was the leader of his time, and he was al-Sharif Abi al-Hasan Ahmad ibn al-Qasim al-Muhammadi.

key_terms.الشَّرِيفُ: the noble descendant; an honorific title
key_terms.الْمُحَمَّدِيِّ: attributed to Muhammad, indicating lineage or affiliation

ai.seo_question: Who was described as the leader of his time in this gathering report?
ai.summary: This passage briefly identifies a gathering and describes its host as the leading notable of his time. It serves a biographical and social-descriptive function, preserving the stature and identity of al-Sharif Abi al-Hasan Ahmad ibn al-Qasim al-Muhammadi.
